brief:
Pilot card · Esper (WUB) · Tier 2 · Proxy · GoT deck 2
 Chaos is a Ladder
 Merieke Ri Berit
 MERIEKE RI BERIT
 W U B 
 printed: Bran the Broken · Human · MV 3
 Merieke Ri Berit doesn't untap during your untap step. {T}: Gain control of target creature for as long as you control Merieke Ri Berit. When Merieke Ri Berit leaves the battlefield or becomes untapped, destroy that creature. It can't be regenerated.
 It dies under your control, so your "creature you control dies" drains fire.
 1/1 
 ↻ Every turn: stay chill, watch everything, strike at the end
 1
 Set up schemes
 Rocks, then plot ( Petyr Baelish plays off the top), foretell, suspend. Draw quietly. Don't attack. 
 2
 Bran, turn 3–4
 Swiftfoot Boots or Thousand-Year Elixir gives haste: steal the same turn.
 3
 Steal and hold
 Take the biggest threat and don't untap . Kenrith above all : off his side, and you use his {3}{U} draw.
 4
 Build the gun
 Freed from the Real / Pemmin's Aura on Bran; drainers Bastion, Zulaport, Amalgam ; ammo from Court of Grace, both Elspeths .
 5
 Strike at the end
 When the table is low: Repay in Kind . Next turn, fire the gun.
 Steal first: 
 Kenrith / their commander › 
 Biggest threat to you › 
 An engine creature › 
 A body to shoot later 
 Rules that decide games
 - Untap = kill. Each untap destroys the last steal; tap again for the next. Freed: {U} per shot. Illusionist's Bracers copies the steal: two per tap.
 - Indestructible survives the untap. You keep it while Bran stays.
 - Holding beats killing Kenrith. Destroyed, he goes to the command zone (+2 tax). Held, he's gone.
 - Can't target Progenitus , and a destroy just shuffles it back. Use Council's Judgment, Sheoldred's Edict, Tergrid's Shadow, Doomskar , or counter it.
 - Garland : an opponent becomes monarch, you take one of their creatures while they keep the crown. Stolen creatures can't be sacrificed . Cast before Court of Grace .
 - Thieving Amalgam: each stolen creature that dies costs its owner 2 .
 Mulligan
 3+ lands and a 1–3 play: keep.
 A rock, Bran, a scheme card. Ship hands of only 6–7 drops or only answers.
 Traps
 - Aminatou −1 on Bran kills the stolen creature and brings him back summoning sick.
 - Austere Command "MV 4+" also kills your Garland, Amalgam and a held Kenrith.
 - Repay drops you too. Fire the gun the turn after; they get one turn.
 - Tragic Slip targets: useless against Progenitus.
 - An early shot shows the plan. Chill until the end.
 How you win: the machine gun

 Other untaps: Teferi (+1 every turn), Granite Witness and Essence of Antiquity face up, Staff of Domination ({3}). Backup: Sorin Markov −3 sets one player to 10.
